body.text: Start at the lower back corner and follow the body round: over the boot, the low roof, and down the bonnet.

windows.text: Draw the rear window under the back of the roof, then the front one beside it, leaving a pillar between.

wheels.text: Two matching circles under the body, one near each end. Line up their centres so the car sits level.

lights-bumpers.text: Add a small light at each end, then the two rounded bumpers with their short dark inserts below.

red-body.text: Colour the body bright red, keeping the windows and wheels clear.

windows-trim.text: Pale grey for the glass and the wheel centres, then a medium grey on the reflections and bumper faces.

wheels-dark.text: Fill the tyres and hubs dark grey, leaving the pale inner rings showing.

body-trim.text: Run a dark red along the slim trim bands on the side.

finishing-colours.text: Yellow for the lamps, black for the bumper inserts, and the car is done.
